lessons.label: facebook_post
lessons.reason: Facebook post 122168640326655685 went live after the viral judge scored 7.0 and the ladder logged FALLBACK LADDER EXHAUSTED
lessons.feedback: Hook is strong and personal but the curiosity gap closes too slowly — the Purista reveal arrives late in the body. Shareability and comment trigger rely on generic templates ('Save before grocery run', 'Share with coffee lover') instead of a specific insight from the story (e.g., the crema test, the ingredient-list moment). Follow CTA gives no distinct reason.
lessons.fix: Do not publish below 8.0. Name the jar in the first sentences, close the loop with one specific insight, and give a distinct follow reason.
